skills.name: Whole number place value
skills.desc: Read, write, compare, and order multi-digit whole numbers using place-value understanding.
next_desc: integer concepts on the number line (MS)

skills.name: Round whole numbers
skills.desc: Round whole numbers to any place and use rounding to estimate sums and differences.
next_desc: estimating with decimals and assessing reasonableness (MS)

skills.name: Multi-digit addition subtraction
skills.desc: Fluently add and subtract multi-digit whole numbers using the standard algorithm.

skills.name: Multiplication concepts and facts
skills.desc: Interpret multiplication as equal groups and arrays and fluently recall products of one-digit factors.

skills.name: Division concepts and facts
skills.desc: Interpret division as equal sharing or grouping and use fact families to divide within 100.

skills.name: Multi-digit multiplication
skills.desc: Multiply multi-digit whole numbers using place-value strategies and the standard algorithm.

skills.name: Multi-digit division
skills.desc: Divide multi-digit whole numbers by one- and two-digit divisors and interpret remainders in context.

skills.name: Factors and multiples
skills.desc: Find factor pairs and multiples and classify whole numbers as prime or composite.

skills.name: Fractions as numbers
skills.desc: Understand unit fractions as equal parts of a whole and locate fractions on the number line.
next_desc: rational numbers on the number line (MS)

skills.name: Decimal place value
skills.desc: Read, write, compare, and round decimals to thousandths using place-value understanding.

skills.name: Add subtract fractions
skills.desc: Add and subtract fractions and mixed numbers, including with unlike denominators.
next_desc: operations on positive and negative rationals (MS)

skills.name: Multiply fractions
skills.desc: Multiply fractions by whole numbers and by fractions, including in area contexts.

skills.name: Divide with unit fractions
skills.desc: Divide unit fractions by whole numbers and whole numbers by unit fractions using models.

skills.name: Decimal operations
skills.desc: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide decimals to hundredths using place-value strategies.
next_desc: decimal operations fluency with standard algorithms (MS)

skills.name: Equivalent fractions
skills.desc: Generate and recognize equivalent fractions using visual models and multiplication.

skills.name: Compare fractions
skills.desc: Compare fractions with different numerators and denominators using benchmarks and common denominators.

skills.name: Multiplicative comparison
skills.desc: Interpret and solve problems where one quantity is a whole-number times as much as another.

skills.name: Relate fractions and decimals
skills.desc: Write fractions with denominators 10 and 100 as decimals and compare quantities across notations.

skills.name: Fraction scaling
skills.desc: Interpret multiplication as scaling and predict whether a product is larger or smaller than its factors.
next_desc: proportional relationships and constant of proportionality (MS)

skills.name: Convert measurement units
skills.desc: Convert among units within the same measurement system to solve multi-step problems.

skills.name: Meaning of equality
skills.desc: Interpret the equal sign as 'has the same value as' and decide whether equations are true or false.

skills.name: Properties of operations
skills.desc: Apply commutative, associative, and distributive properties to compute flexibly and check results.

skills.name: Unknowns in equations
skills.desc: Find the unknown whole number in addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division equations.

skills.name: Two-step word problems
skills.desc: Represent two-step word problems with equations using a letter for the unknown and assess reasonableness.

skills.name: Order of operations
skills.desc: Evaluate numerical expressions containing parentheses, brackets, and braces.

skills.name: Interpret numerical expressions
skills.desc: Write and interpret numerical expressions from verbal descriptions without evaluating them.

skills.name: Arithmetic patterns
skills.desc: Identify and explain arithmetic patterns in addition and multiplication tables.

skills.name: Generate number patterns
skills.desc: Generate a number or shape pattern that follows a given rule and identify features of the pattern.

skills.name: Input-output rules
skills.desc: Complete input-output tables and describe the rule relating inputs to outputs.

skills.name: Relate two patterns
skills.desc: Generate two numerical patterns from rules and identify relationships between corresponding terms.

skills.name: Graph pattern pairs
skills.desc: Form ordered pairs from two related patterns and graph them in the first quadrant.

skills.name: Shape attributes
skills.desc: Classify quadrilaterals and other polygons by shared attributes such as sides and angles.
next_desc: classifying figures by angle and side relationships (MS)

skills.name: Perimeter
skills.desc: Find perimeters of polygons, including finding an unknown side length from the perimeter.

skills.name: Area of rectangles
skills.desc: Understand area as covering with unit squares and find rectangle areas by multiplying side lengths.
next_desc: areas of triangles, quadrilaterals, and composite figures (MS)

skills.name: Lines and angles
skills.desc: Identify points, lines, rays, parallel and perpendicular lines, and acute, right, and obtuse angles.

skills.name: Measure angles
skills.desc: Measure and sketch angles in degrees and solve additive angle problems.

skills.name: Line symmetry
skills.desc: Identify lines of symmetry and complete or draw figures with line symmetry.

skills.name: Classify two-dimensional figures
skills.desc: Classify two-dimensional figures in a hierarchy based on their properties.
next_desc: definitions and figure properties in proofs (GEO)

skills.name: Volume of prisms
skills.desc: Understand volume as packing unit cubes and compute volumes of rectangular prisms.

skills.name: Coordinate plane basics
skills.desc: Graph and interpret points in the first quadrant of the coordinate plane.

skills.name: Bar and picture graphs
skills.desc: Draw and interpret scaled picture graphs and bar graphs and solve one- and two-step data questions.
prereq_desc: sorting and counting objects in categories (K–2)

skills.name: Line plots
skills.desc: Make line plots with fractional measurements and answer questions using operations on the data.

skills.name: Interpret line graphs
skills.desc: Read and interpret line graphs that show how a quantity changes over time.

skills.name: Describe likelihood
skills.desc: Describe events as certain, likely, unlikely, or impossible and compare chances informally.

skills.name: Decimal operations fluency
skills.desc: Fluently add, subtract, multiply, and divide multi-digit decimals using standard algorithms.

skills.name: Fraction division
skills.desc: Divide fractions by fractions using models and algorithms and interpret quotients in context.

skills.name: GCF and LCM
skills.desc: Find greatest common factors and least common multiples and use the distributive property to rewrite sums.

skills.name: Integer concepts
skills.desc: Understand positive and negative numbers, opposites, and absolute value on the number line.
prereq_desc: whole numbers and fractions on the number line (ELEM)

skills.name: Compare rational numbers
skills.desc: Order and compare rational numbers and interpret inequality statements in real-world contexts.
next_desc: interval notation and number-line solution sets (ALG1)

skills.name: Add subtract integers
skills.desc: Add and subtract integers and other signed rationals using number lines and additive inverses.

skills.name: Multiply divide integers
skills.desc: Multiply and divide signed numbers and apply sign rules to evaluate expressions.

skills.name: Rational number operations
skills.desc: Solve multi-step problems using the four operations on positive and negative rational numbers.

skills.name: Integer exponent properties
skills.desc: Apply properties of integer exponents, including negative exponents, to generate equivalent expressions.
prereq_desc: whole-number exponents in expressions (ELEM order of operations)

skills.name: Scientific notation
skills.desc: Express and compute with very large and very small quantities using scientific notation.

skills.name: Roots and irrationals
skills.desc: Evaluate square and cube roots and classify and approximate irrational numbers on the number line.

skills.name: Ratio concepts
skills.desc: Understand ratios and use ratio language to describe relationships between quantities.

skills.name: Equivalent ratios
skills.desc: Generate and use equivalent ratios with tables, tape diagrams, and double number lines.

skills.name: Unit rates
skills.desc: Compute and interpret unit rates, including rates with fractional quantities.
next_desc: slope as a rate of change (ALG1)

skills.name: Percent of a quantity
skills.desc: Find a percent of a quantity and find the whole given a part and the percent.

skills.name: Proportional relationships
skills.desc: Decide whether two quantities are proportional and identify the constant of proportionality.

skills.name: Solve proportions
skills.desc: Write and solve proportion equations for multi-step real-world ratio problems.

skills.name: Multi-step percent problems
skills.desc: Solve percent problems involving tax, tip, discount, markup, simple interest, and percent change.

skills.name: Scale drawings
skills.desc: Solve problems involving scale drawings, computing actual lengths and areas from a scale factor.

skills.name: Algebraic expressions
skills.desc: Write, read, and evaluate algebraic expressions with variables, including whole-number exponents.
prereq_desc: order of operations and interpreting numerical expressions (ELEM)

skills.name: Equivalent expressions
skills.desc: Apply properties of operations to generate equivalent expressions and combine like terms.

skills.name: One-step equations
skills.desc: Solve one-step equations in one variable and check solutions by substitution.

skills.name: Inequality basics
skills.desc: Write, interpret, and graph simple inequalities of the form x > c or x < c on the number line.

skills.name: Two-step equations
skills.desc: Solve two-step equations, including equations with rational number coefficients.

skills.name: Expand and factor
skills.desc: Expand and factor linear expressions with rational coefficients using the distributive property.

skills.name: Two-step inequalities
skills.desc: Solve and graph two-step inequalities and interpret the solution set in context.

skills.name: Multi-step linear equations
skills.desc: Solve linear equations with variables on both sides, including cases with no or infinitely many solutions.

skills.name: Systems of equations
skills.desc: Solve pairs of simultaneous linear equations by graphing and substitution and interpret solutions.

skills.name: Order of operations with exponents
skills.desc: Evaluate numerical expressions involving whole-number exponents, grouping symbols, and the four operations.

skills.name: Two-variable relationships
skills.desc: Analyze relationships between independent and dependent variables using tables, graphs, and equations.
prereq_desc: input-output rules and graphing pattern pairs (ELEM)

skills.name: Function concept
skills.desc: Understand a function as a rule that assigns exactly one output to each input.

skills.name: Slope
skills.desc: Interpret slope as a unit rate and derive it from graphs, tables, and similar triangles.

skills.name: Graph linear equations
skills.desc: Graph and interpret linear equations in the form y = mx + b, identifying slope and intercept.

skills.name: Compare functions
skills.desc: Compare properties of two functions each represented in a different way, such as table versus graph.

skills.name: Linear versus nonlinear
skills.desc: Classify functions as linear or nonlinear and sketch or describe qualitative graph behavior.

skills.name: Area of polygons
skills.desc: Find areas of triangles, special quadrilaterals, and composite figures by composing and decomposing.

skills.desc: Represent solids with nets and compute surface areas of prisms and pyramids.

next_desc: volumes of oblique solids and Cavalieri's principle (GEO)

skills.name: Four-quadrant coordinate plane
skills.desc: Graph points in all four quadrants and find distances between points that share a coordinate.

skills.desc: Use complementary, supplementary, vertical, and adjacent angles, triangle angle sums, and parallel-line transversal angles to find unknown measures.

skills.name: Circles

skills.name: Cylinders cones spheres

skills.name: Probability of events
skills.desc: Find and interpret probabilities of simple events and compare predictions with experimental results.

skills.name: Compound probability
skills.desc: Find probabilities of compound events using organized lists, tables, tree diagrams, and simulation.

skills.name: Bivariate data
skills.desc: Construct and interpret scatter plots and two-way tables and informally fit lines to linear data.

skills.name: Rational vs irrational
skills.desc: Classify real numbers as rational or irrational and reason about sums and products of the two types.

next_desc: measurement conversions for area and volume (GEO)

skills.name: Exponential functions
skills.desc: Graph and analyze exponential functions, including base e, growth versus decay, and asymptotes.

skills.name: Logarithmic functions
skills.desc: Define logarithms as inverses of exponentials, evaluate logs, and graph logarithmic functions.

skills.name: Exponential log modeling
skills.desc: Model half-life, doubling time, and continuous growth, solving for time with logarithms.

skills.name: Series and sigma
skills.desc: Evaluate arithmetic, finite geometric, and convergent infinite geometric series using sigma notation.

skills.name: Unit circle radians
skills.desc: Convert between degrees and radians and evaluate sine, cosine, and tangent at unit-circle angles.
next_desc: all six trig functions and identities (PREC)

skills.name: Graph sine cosine
skills.desc: Graph sine and cosine functions, identifying amplitude, period, midline, and phase shift.

skills.name: Periodic modeling
skills.desc: Write sinusoidal models for periodic phenomena and interpret their parameters.

skills.name: Parabola focus directrix
skills.desc: Derive and use the equation of a parabola from its focus and directrix.

skills.name: Circles ellipses hyperbolas
skills.desc: Write and graph equations of circles, ellipses, and hyperbolas by completing the square.

skills.name: Study design
skills.desc: Distinguish surveys, experiments, and observational studies and identify sources of bias in sampling.

skills.name: Normal distributions
skills.desc: Use the empirical rule and z-scores to estimate proportions under a normal curve.

skills.name: Simulation and inference
skills.desc: Use simulation to estimate margins of error and judge whether a difference is plausibly due to chance.

skills.name: Permutations combinations
skills.desc: Count outcomes using the fundamental counting principle, permutations, and combinations.

skills.name: Binomial probability
skills.desc: Compute binomial probabilities with combinations and find the expected value of a random process.

skills.name: Complex number operations
skills.desc: Add, subtract, multiply, and divide complex numbers, including powers of i and use of conjugates.

skills.name: Complex polar form
skills.desc: Plot complex numbers in the complex plane, find modulus and argument, and convert between rectangular and trigonometric form.

skills.name: De Moivre's theorem
skills.desc: Use De Moivre's theorem to compute powers and nth roots of complex numbers in polar form.
next_desc: complex exponentials and roots of unity (college)

skills.name: Radian measure
skills.desc: Define the radian as an arc-to-radius ratio, convert between degrees and radians, and compute arc length s = rθ.
prereq_desc: circle circumference and arc length proportions (GEO)

skills.name: Angular and linear speed
skills.desc: Relate angular speed and linear speed for circular motion and solve rate problems involving rotating objects.

skills.name: Law of Sines
skills.desc: Use the Law of Sines to solve oblique triangles, including analysis of the ambiguous case.

skills.name: Law of Cosines
skills.desc: Use the Law of Cosines and the area formula (1/2)ab·sin C to solve and measure oblique triangles.

skills.name: Polynomial division theorems
skills.desc: Divide polynomials using long or synthetic division and apply the Remainder and Factor Theorems.

skills.name: Complex polynomial zeros
skills.desc: Find all real and complex zeros of a polynomial using the Fundamental Theorem of Algebra and conjugate pairs.

skills.name: Polynomial rational inequalities
skills.desc: Solve polynomial and rational inequalities using sign charts and zero/undefined boundary analysis.

skills.name: Logarithm properties
skills.desc: Expand, condense, and evaluate logarithmic expressions using product, quotient, power, and change-of-base rules.

skills.name: Exponential log equations
skills.desc: Solve exponential and logarithmic equations, checking for extraneous solutions from domain restrictions.
next_desc: separation of variables with initial conditions (CALC)

skills.name: Fundamental trig identities
skills.desc: Simplify expressions and verify identities using Pythagorean, reciprocal, quotient, and even-odd identities.

skills.name: Angle sum formulas
skills.desc: Apply sum, difference, and double-angle formulas to evaluate expressions and verify identities.

skills.name: Trigonometric equations
skills.desc: Solve trigonometric equations on a given interval and express general solutions using periodicity.
next_desc: finding critical points of trig functions (CALC)

skills.name: Matrix operations
skills.desc: Add, scale, and multiply matrices, attending to dimension compatibility and non-commutativity.

skills.name: Matrix inverses and systems
skills.desc: Compute 2×2 determinants and inverses and use inverse matrices to solve linear systems.

skills.name: Rates of change
skills.desc: Compute average rates of change over intervals and describe where functions increase, decrease, or change concavity.

skills.name: Function transformations
skills.desc: Graph and write functions built from parent functions using combined shifts, stretches, and reflections.

skills.name: Function composition
skills.desc: Compose functions, determine domains of compositions, and decompose a function into simpler components.

skills.name: Inverse functions
skills.desc: Find and verify inverse functions, restrict domains for invertibility, and relate graphs across the line y = x.

skills.name: Polynomial function graphs
skills.desc: Analyze polynomial graphs using end behavior with limit notation, zeros with multiplicity, and local extrema.

skills.name: Rational function graphs
skills.desc: Graph rational functions by identifying holes, vertical and horizontal or slant asymptotes, and intercepts.

skills.name: Power functions
skills.desc: Analyze power functions with rational exponents, including inverse variation, symmetry, and end behavior.

skills.name: Exponential functions
skills.desc: Graph and interpret exponential growth and decay functions, including base e and compound interest models.

skills.name: Logarithmic functions
skills.desc: Define logarithms as inverses of exponentials, evaluate logs, and graph logarithmic functions with domain analysis.

skills.name: Sequences as functions
skills.desc: Write explicit forms of arithmetic and geometric sequences and connect them to linear and exponential functions.

skills.name: Sinusoidal graphs
skills.desc: Graph sine and cosine functions and identify amplitude, period, midline, and phase shift from graphs or equations.

skills.name: Other trig graphs
skills.desc: Graph tangent, cotangent, secant, and cosecant functions, identifying period, asymptotes, and range.
next_desc: derivatives of all six trig functions (CALC)

skills.name: Inverse trig functions
skills.desc: Evaluate inverse sine, cosine, and tangent using restricted domains and compose trig with inverse trig functions.

skills.name: Parametric functions
skills.desc: Graph parametric curves, eliminate the parameter, and interpret parametric equations as planar motion.

skills.name: Polar function graphs
skills.desc: Graph polar functions such as circles, roses, and limaçons and describe how r changes as θ varies.

skills.name: Unit circle values
skills.desc: Use the unit circle to find exact sine, cosine, and tangent values for special angles in all quadrants.

skills.name: Polar coordinates
skills.desc: Plot points in polar coordinates and convert points and simple equations between rectangular and polar form.

skills.name: Vector components
skills.desc: Express vectors in component form, compute magnitude and direction, and perform addition and scalar multiplication.

skills.name: Vector applications
skills.desc: Use unit vectors, dot products, and vector sums to model force, velocity, and navigation problems.

skills.name: Matrix transformations
skills.desc: Interpret 2×2 matrices as linear transformations of the plane and the determinant as an area scaling factor.

skills.name: Conic sections
skills.desc: Identify and graph circles, ellipses, parabolas, and hyperbolas from standard-form equations.

skills.name: Function model selection
skills.desc: Choose an appropriate function type for a data set or context using growth patterns, residuals, and domain constraints.

skills.name: Exponential model fitting
skills.desc: Fit exponential models to data and use semi-log plots to recognize and linearize exponential relationships.

skills.name: Sinusoidal modeling
skills.desc: Build sinusoidal models from periodic data or contexts such as tides and temperatures, and use them to predict values.
next_desc: rates of change of periodic models (CALC)

skills.name: Growth rate comparison
skills.desc: Compare the relative magnitudes of logarithmic, polynomial, and exponential expressions in limits at infinity.

skills.name: L'Hopital's rule
skills.desc: Recognize 0/0 and ∞/∞ indeterminate forms and apply L'Hopital's rule after verifying its conditions.
next_desc: improper integrals and series limits (BC calculus)

skills.name: Derivatives in context
skills.desc: Interpret the meaning and units of a derivative in applied contexts as an instantaneous rate of change.

skills.name: Related rates
skills.desc: Set up equations relating changing quantities and differentiate with respect to time to solve related-rates problems.

skills.name: Linearization and differentials
skills.desc: Use tangent-line approximations and differentials to estimate values and classify over- or underestimates via concavity.
next_desc: Euler's method and Taylor polynomials (BC calculus)

skills.name: Algebraic limit evaluation
skills.desc: Evaluate limits by factoring, rationalizing, and combining fractions to resolve 0/0 indeterminate forms algebraically.

skills.name: Piecewise parameter problems
skills.desc: Solve for parameter values that make piecewise-defined functions continuous or differentiable at a boundary.
next_desc: continuity and differentiability justifications on the AP exam (CALC)

skills.name: Implicit differentiation
skills.desc: Differentiate relations defined implicitly, solve for dy/dx, and find tangent lines to implicit curves.

skills.name: Rewriting integrands
skills.desc: Rewrite integrands using algebraic manipulation, long division, and identities to match basic antiderivative forms.
next_desc: integration by parts and partial fractions (BC calculus)

skills.name: Estimating limits
skills.desc: Estimate limits and one-sided limits from graphs and tables and decide when a limit fails to exist.

skills.name: Limit laws
skills.desc: Evaluate limits using limit properties, direct substitution, and limits of composite functions.

skills.name: Squeeze theorem
skills.desc: Apply the squeeze theorem and the special limits of sin(x)/x and (1−cos x)/x as x approaches 0.

skills.name: Limits involving infinity
skills.desc: Evaluate infinite limits and limits at infinity and connect them to vertical and horizontal asymptotes.

skills.name: Continuity
skills.desc: Apply the three-part definition of continuity and classify removable, jump, and infinite discontinuities.

skills.name: Intermediate Value Theorem
skills.desc: Use the Intermediate Value Theorem to justify the existence of solutions on an interval for continuous functions.
next_desc: existence theorem justifications on the AP exam (CALC)

skills.name: Derivative definition
skills.desc: Define the derivative as a limit of difference quotients and compute derivatives at a point and as a function.

skills.name: Differentiability and graphs
skills.desc: Determine where a function is differentiable, relate differentiability to continuity, and sketch f′ from the graph of f.

skills.name: Basic derivative rules
skills.desc: Differentiate using power, sum, and constant-multiple rules along with derivatives of sin x, cos x, e^x, and ln x.
prereq_desc: exponent rules for rewriting radicals and quotients (ALG2)

skills.name: Product quotient rules
skills.desc: Differentiate products and quotients of functions, including the remaining trigonometric derivatives.

skills.name: Chain rule
skills.desc: Differentiate composite functions with the chain rule, including combinations with product and quotient rules.

skills.name: Inverse function derivatives
skills.desc: Differentiate inverse functions using the reciprocal relationship and find derivatives of inverse trig functions.

skills.name: Higher-order derivatives
skills.desc: Compute and notate second and higher derivatives and interpret the second derivative as the rate of change of a rate.

skills.name: Straight-line motion
skills.desc: Analyze position, velocity, acceleration, and speed for particles in rectilinear motion using derivatives.

skills.name: Mean Value Theorem
skills.desc: Verify hypotheses and apply the Mean Value Theorem and Rolle's Theorem to draw conclusions about derivatives.

skills.name: Absolute extrema
skills.desc: Find critical points and use the Extreme Value Theorem and candidates test to locate absolute extrema on closed intervals.

skills.name: First derivative test
skills.desc: Use the sign of f′ to determine intervals of increase and decrease and classify relative extrema.

skills.name: Concavity and inflection
skills.desc: Use the sign of f″ to determine concavity and inflection points and apply the second derivative test.

skills.name: Connecting function graphs
skills.desc: Move among the graphs and behaviors of f, f′, and f″ to sketch curves and justify features of each.

skills.name: Optimization
skills.desc: Model applied problems with a function of one variable and use derivative tests to find and justify optimal values.
prereq_desc: geometric formulas for area, volume, and perimeter (GEO)

skills.name: Antiderivatives
skills.desc: Find general antiderivatives using basic rules and solve for constants of integration from initial conditions.

skills.name: Definite integral definition
skills.desc: Express definite integrals as limits of Riemann sums and apply linearity and interval-splitting properties.

skills.name: Fundamental Theorem
skills.desc: Evaluate definite integrals using antiderivatives via the Fundamental Theorem of Calculus.

skills.name: Accumulation functions
skills.desc: Analyze functions defined by integrals, using FTC Part 1 to differentiate them and integrand graphs to describe behavior.

skills.name: U-substitution
skills.desc: Evaluate indefinite and definite integrals by substitution, including changing limits of integration.

skills.name: Average value
skills.desc: Compute the average value of a function on an interval and connect it to the Mean Value Theorem for integrals.
next_desc: average versus instantaneous comparisons in applications (CALC)

skills.name: Slope fields
skills.desc: Verify solutions to differential equations and sketch or match slope fields to equations and solution curves.

skills.name: Separation of variables
skills.desc: Solve separable differential equations with initial conditions, including exponential growth and decay models dy/dt = ky.

skills.name: Accumulation in context
skills.desc: Interpret definite integrals of rates as net change and solve rate-in/rate-out accumulation problems.

skills.name: Motion with integrals
skills.desc: Use integrals of velocity and acceleration to find displacement, total distance traveled, and position.

skills.name: Area between curves
skills.desc: Set up and evaluate integrals for regions between curves, integrating with respect to x or y as appropriate.

skills.name: Cross-section volumes
skills.desc: Compute volumes of solids with known cross sections such as squares, semicircles, and triangles on a planar base.

skills.name: Volumes of revolution
skills.desc: Compute volumes of solids of revolution using disk and washer methods about horizontal and vertical axes.
next_desc: shell method and arc length (BC calculus)

skills.name: Table derivative estimates
skills.desc: Estimate derivatives from tabular data using difference quotients over the smallest available intervals.

skills.name: Riemann sum approximation
skills.desc: Approximate definite integrals from tables or graphs using left, right, midpoint, and trapezoidal sums, classifying over- and underestimates.

skills.name: Probability models
skills.desc: Develop uniform and non-uniform probability models, use them to find probabilities of events, and compare model predictions with observed frequencies.

skills.name: Quadratic and exponential fits
skills.desc: Fit quadratic and exponential functions to scatter plot data, choose between model types, and use the fitted function to answer questions in context.

skills.name: Random variables
skills.desc: Define a random variable by assigning a numerical value to each outcome in a sample space and graph its probability distribution.

skills.name: Empirical probability distributions
skills.desc: Build a probability distribution for a random variable from observed data, assign probabilities empirically, and find and interpret its expected value.

skills.name: Expected payoff
skills.desc: Weigh the outcomes of a decision by assigning probabilities to payoff values and finding expected values, including the expected payoff of a game of chance.

skills.name: Decisions using probability
skills.desc: Compare strategies on the basis of expected value, use probability to make fair decisions, and analyze decisions such as product testing or medical testing.
next_desc: Type I and Type II error (STAT)

skills.name: Evaluate data reports
skills.desc: Critique published reports and media claims based on data by examining the study design, the sampling method, the displays used, and whether the conclusions follow.

skills.name: Study design and randomization
skills.desc: Distinguish random sampling methods and experimental designs, and identify confounding, blocking, and the role of randomization in each.

skills.name: Scope of inference
skills.desc: Decide what a study permits by linking random selection to generalization and random assignment to causal claims.

skills.name: Least-squares regression
skills.desc: Compute and interpret the least-squares regression line, r, and r-squared, and use residual plots and influential points to assess the fit.

skills.name: Transformations to achieve linearity
skills.desc: Apply logarithmic and power transformations to curved bivariate data and interpret regression output on the transformed scale.

skills.name: Discrete random variables
skills.desc: Compute and interpret the mean and standard deviation of a discrete random variable from its probability distribution.

skills.name: Combining random variables
skills.desc: Find the mean and standard deviation of sums and differences of random variables, using independence where it applies.

skills.name: Binomial and geometric distributions
skills.desc: Identify binomial and geometric settings and compute their probabilities, means, and standard deviations.

skills.name: Normal distribution calculations
skills.desc: Find probabilities, percentiles, and cutoff values for normal models using z-scores with technology or tables, and judge when a normal model is appropriate.

skills.name: Sampling variability
skills.desc: Explain why a statistic varies from sample to sample, describe the sampling distribution of a statistic, and distinguish bias from variability.

skills.name: Sampling distribution of a proportion
skills.desc: Describe the shape, center, and standard deviation of the sampling distribution of a sample proportion and check the conditions for a normal approximation.

skills.name: Sampling distribution of a mean
skills.desc: Describe the sampling distribution of a sample mean and apply the Central Limit Theorem to judge when a normal model is reasonable.

skills.name: Sampling distributions of differences
skills.desc: Describe the sampling distributions of a difference of two sample proportions and of two sample means.

skills.name: Confidence interval for a proportion
skills.desc: Construct and interpret a confidence interval for a population proportion, checking conditions and reporting the margin of error.

skills.name: Confidence interval for a mean
skills.desc: Construct and interpret a t confidence interval for a population mean, checking conditions and explaining why t replaces z.

skills.name: Interpreting confidence intervals
skills.desc: Interpret confidence level correctly, explain what changing sample size or confidence level does to interval width, and identify common misinterpretations.

skills.name: Simulation-based inference
skills.desc: Use randomization and resampling simulations to build a distribution of a statistic under a null model and judge whether an observed result is surprising.

skills.name: Logic of significance testing
skills.desc: State null and alternative hypotheses, define a test statistic and p-value, and draw a conclusion in context against a significance level.

skills.name: Test for a proportion
skills.desc: Carry out a one-sample z test for a population proportion, checking conditions and interpreting the p-value in context.

skills.name: Test for a mean
skills.desc: Carry out a one-sample t test for a population mean, checking conditions and interpreting the p-value in context.

skills.name: Errors and power
skills.desc: Distinguish Type I and Type II errors, describe their consequences in context, and explain what affects the power of a test.

skills.name: Two-proportion inference
skills.desc: Construct confidence intervals and carry out significance tests for the difference between two population proportions.

skills.name: Two-sample mean inference
skills.desc: Construct confidence intervals and carry out two-sample t tests for the difference between two population means.

skills.name: Paired data inference
skills.desc: Recognize paired designs and analyze them with one-sample procedures applied to the differences.

skills.name: Chi-square goodness of fit
skills.desc: Test whether a categorical distribution matches a hypothesized model using a chi-square goodness-of-fit test.
prereq_desc: comparing a probability model to observed frequencies (MS)

skills.name: Chi-square tests for two-way tables
skills.desc: Use chi-square tests of independence and of homogeneity to assess association between two categorical variables, choosing the test from the study design.

skills.name: Inference for regression slope
skills.desc: Construct confidence intervals and carry out t tests for the slope of a least-squares regression line, checking the conditions for regression inference.
